Regex Guide

What every regex script in the presets does, and the tag that brings it onstage.

🌹 Rosie Full Bloom 34 🥀 The Velvet Vigil 8 💌 LOVESICK 12 📋 CALLBOARD 154

🌹 Rosie Full Bloomv2.7 · 34 scripts

Turn on Regex Keepsakes (or a board, report, or HEX/SELARU module) in the preset, and Rosie writes these short bracket tags. The regexes draw them as cards. Download the bundle.

Keepsakes

Small cards Rosie drops into the story.

  • 🌹 Rosie Scene Compass

    A pink fold-out card for the current scene: place, time, who's present, mood, the live thread, and a one-line nudge. Tap the title to open it.

    [RSCENE: title | place | time | present | mood | thread | nudge]
  • 💌 Rosie Ship Ledger

    A card for a pairing: where they stand, the heat, what's in the way, the payoff it's building to, and a note.

    [RSHIP: pair | stage | heat | obstacle | payoff | note]
  • 📱 Rosie Phone Message

    Draws a text message as a phone screen, with the contact, time, delivery status, and message bubble.

    [RPHONE: contact | time | status | message]
  • 🧭 Rosie Quest Card

    A quest card: the current step, what comes next, the risk, and the reward.

    [RQUEST: title | current | next | risk | reward]
  • 🎁 Rosie Inventory Keepsake

    An item card: who owns it, what shape it's in, and what it means to them.

    [RITEM: item | owner | state | meaning | note]
  • 👗 Rosie Wardrobe Card

    What a character is wearing right now, with their posture, one telling detail, and their mood.

    [RWARDROBE: character | outfit | posture | detail | mood | note]
  • 🗣️ Rosie Rumor Board

    A rumor: who started it, who it's about, what's being said, how far it's spread, and what it'll cost.

    [RRUMOR: source | subject | claim | spread | consequence]
  • 💞 Rosie Relationship Map

    Two people side by side, with the bond between them and the tension in it.

    [RREL: title | person_a | person_b | bond | tension | note]

Info boards

Dashboards from the Info Board System. Each one also has an "Always Fire" module.

  • 📋 Rosie General Info Board

    A general-purpose board: a title, two labeled values side by side, and a note.

    [RBOARD: title | subtitle | left label | left value | right label | right value | note]
  • 📍 Rosie Status Board

    The scene at a glance: location, time, pressure, danger, the objective, and what's next.

    [RSTATUS: title | location | time | pressure | danger | objective | next]
  • 👥 Rosie Cast Board

    Who's in the scene, who's nearby, who's missing, and the wild card.

    [RCAST: title | active | nearby | absent | wild card | note]
  • 🧠 Rosie Knowledge Board

    What one character knows, suspects, and doesn't know, and the risk hiding in the gap.

    [RKNOW: title | character | knows | suspects | does not know | risk]
  • 🕯️ Rosie Calendar / Countdown Board

    The date and time, with a countdown to the next deadline or event.

    [RCLOCK: title | date | time | deadline | event | note]
  • 🗂️ Rosie Case Board

    A mystery case file: the lead, the evidence, the suspect, the contradiction, and the next step.

    [RCASE: title | lead | evidence | suspect | contradiction | next]
  • 👑 Rosie Reputation Board

    How the world sees a character: the public read, allies, threats, gossip, and consequences.

    [RREP: title | public read | allies | threats | gossip | consequence]

Status reports

F.A.Y.E.-inspired reports. Turn on the Status Report System and pick a style.

  • 🌹 Rosie SFW Status Report

    A styled status report card for the scene, with Rosie's note at the bottom.

    [RSFWREPORT: title | when/where | mood | pressure | thread | next opening | rosie note]
  • 🌹 Rosie SFW Markdown-Style Status

    A lighter, quote-style version of the same report.

    [RSFWMD: title | when/where | mood | pressure | next opening | rosie note]
  • 🫦 Rosie Velvet Heat Report

    The adults-only report for intimate scenes: adult check, privacy, heat, consent and boundaries, emotional risk, and aftercare.

    [RVELVET: title | adult check | privacy | heat | consent/boundaries | emotional risk | aftercare | next opening | rosie note]
  • 🫦 Rosie Velvet Markdown-Style Status

    A lighter, quote-style version of the Velvet Heat Report.

    [RVELVETMD: title | adult check | privacy | heat | consent/boundaries | next opening | rosie note]
  • 🌹 Rosie AI Affinity Status Board

    The big screenshot-style panel: five stats with their latest changes, what the character understands about you, perceived threats, sweet and sad things, and an internal monologue.

    [RAFFINITY: status | affection % | change | attraction % | change | loyalty % | change | intelligence % | change | intrigue % | change | understanding you | perceived threats | sweet things | sad things | internal monologue]

HEX- and SELARU-style boards

Alternate board styles inspired by HEX's environmental boards and SELARU's in-world objects. Commands like [ROSIE:HEX INFO] call them up.

  • 🔥 Rosie HEX-Style Info Board

    An environmental board: date, season, how much time passed, location, temperature, weather, light, and scene pressure.

    [RHEXINFO: date | season | start time | end time | location | temperature | weather/visibility/light | illumination | scene pressure]
  • 🔥 Rosie HEX-Style Affinity Board

    An affinity board for one character: their read on things, mood, affinity, tension, and physical state, plus a soundtrack and a scenery line.

    [RHEXAFF: focus | thought/meta read | mood | affinity | heat/tension | physical state | soundtrack | scenery]
  • 🌹 Rosie HEX-Style SFW Affinity Board

    The SFW version: public read, mood, affinity, tension, and posture.

    [RHEXAFFSFW: focus | public read | mood | affinity | tension | posture | soundtrack | scenery]
  • 🫦 Rosie HEX-Style Velvet Affinity Board

    The adults-only version, with an adult check, privacy, heat, consent and boundaries, and aftercare.

    [RHEXAFFNSFW: focus | adult check | privacy | heat | consent/boundaries | arousal/tension | physical state | aftercare/aftermath | note]
  • 🪞 Rosie SELARU-Style Diegetic Info Board

    Shows information as an object in the story world, like a sign, a note, or a screen: what it says, how it's used, and how the character reacts.

    [RSELINFO: object type | title | source | visible text/detail | interaction | consequence | character reaction]
  • 🪞 Rosie SELARU-Style Affinity Evidence Board

    Affinity told through evidence you could actually see instead of a number: what's visible, whether it's public, trust, pressure, and risk.

    [RSELAFF: pair/focus | visible evidence | private/public status | trust | pressure | risk | next opening]
  • 📜 Rosie SELARU-Style Document Board

    An in-world document such as a letter, contract, or decree, with its issuer, contents, seal, and consequence.

    [RSELDOC: document type | title | issuer/source | contents | seal/status | consequence | note]
  • 🖥️ Rosie SELARU-Style Terminal Board

    An in-world terminal or device screen, with its status, message, warning, and an action prompt.

    [RSELTERM: interface | status | signal/source | message | warning | action prompt | consequence]

Behind the scenes

These hide things rather than draw them.

  • 🌹 Rosie Secret Stitch Note

    Takes Rosie's private continuity notes out of the reply and files them in the rosie_notes chat variable, so they're remembered but never shown.

    [ROSIE NOTE: note]
    Edits the message itself
  • 🌹 Rosie Chekhov Plant

    Files a planted setup (a Chekhov's gun) in the rosie_planted chat variable instead of showing it.

    [PLANT: setup]
    Edits the message itself
  • 🌹 Rosie Chekhov Fired

    Logs a payoff in the rosie_fired chat variable when a planted setup goes off.

    [FIRED: payoff]
    Edits the message itselfAlso runs on your messages
  • 🌹 Rosie HTML Marker Cleanup

    Removes the invisible ROSIE_HTML start and end markers around Rosie's HTML panels.

  • 🌹 Rosie Macro Cleanup

    Hides any leftover {{addvar}}, {{setvar}}, {{getvar}}, {{incvar}}, or {{decvar}} macros so they never show up in a reply.

  • 🌹 Rosie Prefill Strip

    Removes a "[Continuing in-character…]" prefill if the model echoes it at the start of a reply.

    Edits the message itself

🥀 The Velvet Vigilv3.2.2 · 8 scripts

Turn on 🧵 Loom Mode in the preset, and Vesper writes these light tags instead of full HTML. It's cheaper on tokens and keeps the look consistent. Download the bundle.

Loom fixtures

  • VV - Chapter Plate

    A centered chapter plate: the number and title in small caps over an italic epigraph.

    <plate>Number · Title ♦ epigraph</plate>
  • VV - Scene Ledger

    The Scene Ledger: when, where, who's present, and the open threads.

    <ledger>when ♦ where ♦ present ♦ threads</ledger>
  • VV - Ribbon Ledger

    The Ribbon Ledger for one bond: Affection, Desire, and Trust meters, each with its number and stage.

    <ribbon>Name ♦ Affection NN Stage ♦ Desire NN Stage ♦ Trust NN Stage</ribbon>
  • VV - Ribbon Delta Chip

    A small inline chip for a change to a bond, with the reason.

    [+4 Trust: reason]
  • VV - Vesper Remark

    Vesper's signed remark under a reply, in her burgundy margin style.

    <vesper>remark</vesper>
  • VV - Reading Room Patron

    One Reading Room reader's reaction, with their @handle.

    <patron handle="name">comment</patron>
  • VV - Crossroads Fork

    Draws each of Vesper's Crossroads options as a pill-shaped choice.

    <fork>option</fork>
  • VV - Night Reading Veil

    Wraps the model's reasoning in a 🕯️ "the night reading" fold-out, so it doesn't sprawl across the reply.

    <think>…</think>

💌 LOVESICKv1.4.1 · 12 scripts

Turn on 📶 Signal Mode in the preset, and Juno writes these light tags instead of full HTML. It's cheaper on tokens and keeps the look consistent. Download the bundle.

Screenlife fixtures

  • LS - Chapter Card

    A chapter card with its number and title over an italic epigraph.

    <chapter>No. · title ♦ epigraph</chapter>
  • LS - The Receipts

    The Receipts: when, where, who's there, and the threads in play.

    <receipts>when ♦ where ♦ present ♦ threads</receipts>
  • LS - The Pinboard

    The detailed scene board: when, where, the room, fit check, the vibe, threads, and what's up next. It replaces The Receipts when both are on.

    <pinboard>when ♦ where ♦ the room ♦ fit check ♦ the vibe ♦ threads ♦ up next</pinboard>
  • LS - Group Chat Name

    The group chat's name, as a header above its messages.

    <gcname>chat title</gcname>
  • LS - Group Chat Message

    One group chat bubble with the sender's name.

    <gc handle="name">message</gc>
  • LS - Delulu Meter

    The Delulu Meter for a pairing: Feelings, Heat, and Honesty bars, each with its number and stage.

    <delulu>Name ♦ Feelings NN Stage ♦ Heat NN Stage ♦ Honesty NN Stage</delulu>
  • LS - Delulu Delta Chip

    A small inline chip for a change to Feelings, Heat, or Honesty, with the reason.

    [+6 Honesty: reason]
  • LS - Juno Comment

    Juno's signed comment under a reply, liveblogging your love life.

    <juno>comment</juno>
  • LS - What They Didnt Say

    A 🤫 fold-out holding the line someone didn't say out loud.

    <unsaid>the line</unsaid>
  • LS - The Firsts

    A 💌 fold-out checklist of the relationship's firsts, done and not yet.

    <firsts>✓/○ lines</firsts>
  • LS - Needle Drop

    A small "♪ now playing" line for the scene's song.

    <track>Song — Artist</track>
  • LS - Margin Notes (think)

    Juno's readable reasoning: wraps <think> in a 🖊️ "juno's margin notes" fold-out. You don't need it if SillyTavern's Auto-Parse Reasoning already catches <think> tags.

    <think>…</think>

📋 CALLBOARDv1.5.0 · 154 scripts

CALLBOARD writes data lines, like TW> msg|… for a Twitch message, inside [[SHELL]] tags. Row regexes draw each line, and shell regexes draw the window around them. They ship inside the preset: allow them when SillyTavern asks, or import the bundle. CALLBOARD Lite v1.5.0 uses exactly the same regex. Download the bundle.

Dividers

These also work in your own messages.

  • CB · Divider — Act Break

    Turns the line into a ✦ ✦ ✦ act break.

    a line of ---, ***, ===, or ~~~
    Also runs on your messages
  • CB · Divider — Scene Shift (⁂)

    Turns it into a centered scene-shift mark.

    ⁂ on its own line
    Also runs on your messages
  • CB · Divider — Timeskip (↷)

    Turns it into a "later" timeskip divider.

    ↷, »»», or →→→ on its own line
    Also runs on your messages

Cue Calls and The Program

New in v1.4: Xavi tells you what's about to appear, and what's lit tonight.

  • CB · Cue — standby slip (with legend)

    A gold ● STANDBY slip above whatever's about to appear, with a "What it means" legend. Xavi includes the legend the first time each kind of element shows up.

    CUE> icon|what's coming|why now|what it means
    Also runs on your messages
  • CB · Cue — standby slip

    The same STANDBY slip without the legend, for elements you've already seen.

    CUE> icon|what's coming|why now|
    Also runs on your messages
  • CB · Cue — catch-all (malformed lines)

    Catches cue lines with the wrong number of fields and shows them as a plain STANDBY line.

    Also runs on your messages
  • CB · Shell — The Program

    The theatre-program card listing everything that's lit. It appears on the first reply of a chat, and whenever you send [PROGRAM].

    [[PROGRAM]] … [[/PROGRAM]]
    Also runs on your messages
  • CB · Program row — title

    The program's title: tonight's production in a phrase.

    PG> title|tonight's production
    Also runs on your messages
  • CB · Program row — cast line

    The line under the title: the setting wing, mode, and Xavi's patter and mood.

    PG> cast|wing · mode · patter and mood
    Also runs on your messages
  • CB · Program row — act

    One lit module per line: what sets it off (CUE) and what you'll see.

    PG> act|icon|module|what sets it off|what you'll see
    Also runs on your messages
  • CB · Program row — note from Xavi

    A closing note from Xavi to the director, signed — X.

    PG> note|line
    Also runs on your messages
  • CB · Program row — catch-all (malformed lines)

    Catches program lines with the wrong number of fields and shows them as plain text.

    Also runs on your messages

Plumbing and extras

  • CB · Chat/Press row — catch-all (malformed lines)

    Catches chat, press, or app lines with the wrong number of fields and shows them as plain text instead of breaking the panel.

    Also runs on your messages
  • CB · Chat/Press — join rendered rows

    Removes the line breaks between drawn rows so panels don't get gaps.

    Also runs on your messages
  • CB · Visuals — collapse old chat/press blocks in prompt (optional)

    Swaps chat panels, press pages, app panels, and the Program for a short placeholder in what's sent to the model once they're six or more messages old, to save tokens. What you see doesn't change.

    Only changes what the model seesAlso runs on your messages
  • CB · Extreme — Pollinations image

    Turns an image directive into a picture generated by Pollinations (Flux, 1024×1024). It's the only regex that loads anything from outside, so it needs "Forbid External Media" turned off.

    <cb_img>prompt: … | ar: 16:9</cb_img>

No regex matches that search.
